Supplier - Validate UPI ID when method is UPI
script:
UPI_METHOD = 'UPI'

upi_needed = doc.get('custom_preferred_payment_method') == UPI_METHOD
upi = doc.get('custom_upi_id')

if upi_needed and (not upi or not upi.strip()):
    frappe.throw('UPI ID is required when Preferred Payment Method is UPI.')

name: PNC Decision - Validate PNC Decision fields
script:
SUSPEND_DECISION = 'Suspend'

# Ensure reason is provided when suspending
if doc.get('decision') == SUSPEND_DECISION and not doc.get('reason'):
    frappe.throw('Reason is required when Decision is Suspend.')

# Effective Date must be set
if not doc.get('effective_date'):
    frappe.throw('Effective Date is required.')
